scenarios.title: A spell with web-slinging can be cast for its web-slinging cost by returning a tapped creature to hand
decisions: A casts Spider-Man, Web-Slinger using web-slinging: pays {W} by tapping Plains and returns the tapped Grizzly Bears to A's hand.
Both players pass; Spider-Man, Web-Slinger resolves.

variants.label: tapped_creature_returned
variants.expected: Casting for the web-slinging cost is legal. Grizzly Bears moves from the battlefield to A's hand, and Spider-Man, Web-Slinger (3/3) enters the battlefield.

variants.label: creature_untapped
variants.expected: Casting for the web-slinging cost is not legal: A controls no tapped creature to return, and {W} alone cannot pay the mana cost {2}{W}. Spider-Man stays in A's hand.

variants.label: no_mana_for_web_slinging_cost
variants.expected: Casting for the web-slinging cost is not legal: the {W} of the web-slinging cost cannot be paid. Spider-Man stays in A's hand and Grizzly Bears stays on the battlefield.
